sort_partitioned_local.ddl: (id BIGINT, p INT) USING iceberg PARTITIONED BY (p) TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_partitioned_local.order: WRITE DISTRIBUTED BY PARTITION LOCALLY ORDERED BY id
sort_partitioned_local.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, CAST(id % 2 AS INT) AS p FROM r

sort_unpartitioned_desc.ddl: (id BIGINT, s STRING) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_unpartitioned_desc.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, CAST(id AS STRING) FROM r

sort_two_keys_nulls.ddl: (a INT, b BIGINT) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_two_keys_nulls.order: WRITE ORDERED BY a ASC NULLS LAST, b DESC NULLS FIRST
sort_two_keys_nulls.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT CASE WHEN id % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(id % 5 AS INT) END AS a, CASE WHEN id % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (id * 31) % 97 END AS b FROM r

sort_dataframe_door.ddl: (id BIGINT, p INT) USING iceberg PARTITIONED BY (p) TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_dataframe_door.insert: SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, CAST(id % 2 AS INT) AS p FROM r

sort_distribution_none.ddl: (id BIGINT, p INT) USING iceberg PARTITIONED BY (p) TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_distribution_none.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, CAST(id % 2 AS INT) AS p FROM r

sort_transform_bucket.ddl: (id BIGINT, p INT) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_transform_bucket.order: WRITE ORDERED BY bucket(4, id), id
sort_transform_bucket.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, 1 AS p FROM r

sort_transform_days.ddl: (id BIGINT, ts TIMESTAMP) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_transform_days.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT (id * 7919) % 2000 AS id, CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE '2026-01-01', CAST(id % 40 AS INT)) AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM r

sort_float_nan.ddl: (id BIGINT, f FLOAT) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2')
sort_float_nan.insert: INSERT INTO {t} SELECT id, CASE WHEN id % 13 = 0 THEN CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT) WHEN id % 17 = 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST((id * 7919) % 2000 AS FLOAT) END AS f FROM r
